=== task: install ===

    ;;
    ;;
    ;;
    ;;
    activation_env='eval "$(fnm env --use-on-cd --shell bash)"'
    activation_env='eval "$(fnm env --use-on-cd --shell zsh)"'
    activation_env='fnm env --use-on-cd --shell fish | source'
    activation_path='export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/fnm:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"'
    activation_path='export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/fnm:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"'
    activation_path='set -gx PATH "$HOME/.local/share/fnm" "$HOME/.local/bin" $PATH'
    exit 0
    exit 0
    printf '
    printf '
    printf '
    printf '  eval "$(fnm env --use-on-cd)"
    printf '  export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/fnm:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
    printf 'Shell "%s" is not auto-configured. Add fnm activation manually:
    printf 'fnm is already configured in %s.
    profile_candidates=("$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.bash_profile" "$HOME/.profile")
    profile_candidates=("$HOME/.config/fish/config.fish")
    profile_candidates=("$HOME/.zshrc" "$HOME/.zprofile")
  "$HOME/.zshrc" "$HOME/.zprofile" "$HOME/.config/fish/config.fish"; do
  *)
  [ -f "$profile" ] || continue
  bash)
  elif [ "$has_path" = false ]; then
  else
  exit 0
  fi
  fi
  fish)
  grep -q "fnm env" "$profile" 2>/dev/null && has_env=true
  grep -qF '$HOME/.local/share/fnm' "$f" 2>/dev/null && grep -q "fnm env" "$f" 2>/dev/null && exit 0
  grep -qF '$HOME/.local/share/fnm' "$profile" 2>/dev/null && has_path=true
  has_env=false
  has_path=false
  if [ "$has_path" = false ] && [ "$has_env" = false ]; then
  if [ "$has_path" = true ] && [ "$has_env" = true ]; then
  printf 'Restart your shell or run: source %s
  printf 'fnm activation updated in %s.
  zsh)
 exited non-zero: exit status 2
# fnm (Fast Node Manager)
%s
%s
%s
%s
%s
%s
'
'
' "$activation_env" >> "$profile"
' "$activation_path" "$activation_env" > "$profile"
' "$activation_path" "$activation_env" >> "$profile"
' "$activation_path" >> "$profile"
' "$profile"
' "$profile"
' "$profile"
' "$profile"
' "$profile"
' "${shell_name:-unknown}"
case "$shell_name" in
done
done
esac
exit 1
for profile in "${profile_candidates[@]}"; do
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$profile")"
printf '# fnm (Fast Node Manager)
printf 'Restart your shell or run: source %s
printf 'fnm activation added to %s.
profile="${profile_candidates[0]}"
shell_name="$(basename "${SHELL:-}")"
task: "_install:unix" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_shell:setup:unix" finished
task: "_shell:setup:unix" started
task: "_shell:setup:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: "shell:setup" finished
task: "shell:setup" started
task: Task "_install:unix" is up to date
task: [_shell:setup:unix] echo Configuring fnm shell activation...
task: [_shell:setup:unix] export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/fnm:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
task: status command for f in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.bash_profile" "$HOME/.profile" \
task: status command test -f "$HOME/.local/share/fnm/fnm" || command -v fnm >/dev/null 2>&1 || test -f "$HOME/.local/bin/fnm" exited zero
